dsDescriptionValue.value: Cinema Context is an online MySQL database containing places, persons and companies involved in more than 100,000 film screenings since 1895. CC provides insight into the ‘DNA’ of Dutch film and cinema culture and is praised by film historians worldwide. With a DANS Small Data Project grant, this data set has been converted to a Linked Data format (RDF). This data deposit contains both the RDF data set and the script used to convert the MySQL database into RDF.
